entries.question: Mai int doctor se kaise sampark kar sakta hun
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University mein doctors se sampark karne ke liye, aap vibhinn tareekon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

**1. OPD Appointments ke liye:**

*   **Online Registration:** Sabse pehle, online registration karna anivarya hai. Aap www.ors.gov.in par jaakar ya ors.gov.in website par visit karke appointment book kar sakte hain.
*   **Phone:** Aap in phone numbers par call karke bhi appointment book kar sakte hain:
    *   0522-2258880
    *   0522-3539333
*   **SMS:** Aap "APPOINTMENT <Your Name>" likhkar 8887019134 par SMS bhejkar bhi appointment ka anurodh kar sakte hain.

**2. Vibhinn Vibhagon (Departments) ke liye:**

KGMU mein vibhinn vibhagon ke liye dedicated contact details uplabdh hain. Agar aap kisi vishesh vibhag ke doctor se sampark karna chahte hain, to aap KGMU ki website www.kgmu.org par jaakar "Departments" section mein us vibhag ka direct link dekh sakte hain. Yahan se aap unke contact details ya faculty directory dekh sakte hain.

**3. Faculty Directory:**

Aap KGMU ki website par "Faculty Directory" (https://www.kgmu.org/allfaculty.php) se bhi vibhinn vibhag ke doctors ki jankari prapt kar sakte hain, jisme unke contact details bhi shamil ho sakte hain.

**4. KGMU Helpline:**

KGMU ki helpline number 0522-2258880 par bhi medical salah ke liye sampark kiya ja sakta hai.

Kripya dhyan dein ki OPD ke liye online registration anivarya hai.
entries.ai_question_translated_en: Mai int doctor from how sampark kar sakta hun

entries.question: क्या may gnm ker सकता hu
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU) offers GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) as part of its paramedical courses.

For admission to the GNM program, you generally need to have completed your 10+2 education with science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) and meet the minimum age and academic requirements set by KGMU and the Uttar Pradesh State Medical Faculty.

You can find more detailed information about the admission process, eligibility criteria, and important dates on the KGMU website, specifically in the Paramedical Sciences section.

Would you like me to help you find the relevant section on the KGMU website for paramedical admissions?
entries.ai_question_translated_en: क्या may gnm ker सकता hu

entries.question: Hindi में
entries.answer:
जी हाँ, आप KGMU (किंग जॉर्ज मेडिकल यूनिवर्सिटी) से GNM (जनरल नर्सिंग एंड मिडवाइफरी) कर सकते हैं।

GNM कोर्स में एडमिशन के लिए, आपको आमतौर पर 10+2 (विज्ञान विषय - भौतिकी, रसायन विज्ञान, जीव विज्ञान) पास होना चाहिए और KGMU तथा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य चिकित्सा संकाय द्वारा निर्धारित न्यूनतम आयु और शैक्षणिक योग्यताएं पूरी करनी होंगी।

आप KGMU की वेबसाइट पर, विशेष रूप से पैरामेडिकल विज्ञान अनुभाग में, प्रवेश प्रक्रिया, पात्रता मानदंड और महत्वपूर्ण तिथियों के बारे में अधिक विस्तृत जानकारी पा सकते हैं।

क्या आप चाहेंगे कि मैं आपको KGMU वेबसाइट पर पैरामेडिकल प्रवेश से संबंधित अनुभाग खोजने में मदद करूँ?

entries.question: kgmu nursing officer 2025 ka registration number kaise prapt kare
entries.answer:
KGMU Nursing Officer 2025 ke liye registration number prapt karne ke liye, aapko KGMU ki official website ya unke dwara jari ki gayi official notification ko check karna hoga.

Aam taur par, registration process ke dauran ek unique registration number ya application number diya jata hai. Yadi aapne already apply kar diya hai aur aap apna registration number bhool gaye hain, to aap in tarikon se ise recover kar sakte hain:

1.  **KGMU ki Official Website:** KGMU ki official website par "Login" ya "Forgot Registration Number/Password" ka option check karein. Yahan aap apne registered mobile number ya email ID ka upyog karke apna registration number recover kar sakte hain.
2.  **Official Notification:** Jab KGMU Nursing Officer 2025 ki notification jaari hogi, usmein registration process aur contact details di jayengi. Usmein diye gaye helpline number ya email ID par sampark karke aap madad le sakte hain.
3.  **Application Confirmation:** Yadi aapne application submit karne ke baad confirmation email ya SMS prapt kiya hai, to usmein aapka registration number shamil ho sakta hai.

Kripya KGMU ki official website (www.kgmu.org) par latest updates ke liye nazar rakhein.
